content.title: UK bank fined for breaking Russia sanctions
content.summary: Bank of Scotland (BoS) has been fined by a regulator for breaking sanctions related to Russia's war in Ukraine.  The Office of Financial Sanctions Implementation (OFSI) said ‌a penalty of £160,000 had been imposed over financial transactions dating back to 2023.  OFSI, which oversees compliance with all sanctions levied against Russia on behalf of the UK government, said it had concluded that the ​bank breached prohibitions on dealing with, and making funds available to, a sanctioned person.
